preprocessing: Median imputation and StandardScaler fit on supervised train only
alarm: 1 - normal predict_proba score > normal calibration q95, method=higher
type: For alarms, choose highest score among A121, B82, C182; archived V4 only predicts an alarm

primary.calibration: G0_main399 original V4 calibration block, 100 normal cycles

secondary.calibration: old_nov05_late_normal30 after evening evaluation, MCU reset, retrospective only

inclusion: Prior audited original-cycle records only; exact doses and paired 41 g normals with automatic return. G0 excluded from evaluation. No evaluation label, session/date, mount, dose or command metadata in features.
scope: Retrospective and exploratory. Only one known same-mount bolt anomaly campaign. Old diagnostic campaigns share a calendar date; old normal calibration was collected after diagnostic evaluation.
